title: The 5 Largest Lakes on Earth, Ranked (#1 Is Called a Sea)

scenes.text: The five biggest lakes on Earth, ranked. Number one has the word sea in its name.

scenes.label: Michigan · 57,753 km²
scenes.text: Number five: Lake Michigan. About fifty-eight thousand square kilometers, about the size of Croatia.

scenes.label: Huron · 59,590 km²
scenes.text: Number four: Lake Huron. Nearly sixty thousand square kilometers, with thousands of islands scattered across it.

scenes.label: Victoria · ~60,000 km²
scenes.text: Number three: Lake Victoria, the biggest lake in Africa, shared by three countries and the source of the White Nile.

scenes.label: Superior · 82,103 km²
scenes.text: Number two: Lake Superior. Over eighty-two thousand square kilometers, the biggest freshwater lake on Earth by area.

scenes.label: Caspian Sea · 371,000 km²
scenes.text: Number one: the Caspian Sea. Three hundred seventy-one thousand square kilometers, more than four times Superior, and it counts as a lake.

description:
The five largest lakes on Earth, ranked by surface area.
The number one lake is more than four times bigger than the number two, and it is called a sea.
Which of these had you never heard of?
first_comment: Did you know the Caspian was a lake? What should we rank next?
